title: IAU 2000A nutation series (MHB2000 / SOFA iauNut00a)
description: Luni-solar (678 terms) and planetary (687 terms) nutation coefficients from the MHB2000 model.

ls_columns.description: Column names for luni_solar rows: nl, nlp, nf, nd, nom (Delaunay args), sp, spt, cp, ce, cet, se (nutation coefficients in 0.1 µas).

pl_columns.description: Column names for planetary rows: nl, nf, nd, nom (Delaunay), nme, nve, nea, nma, nju, nsa, nur, nne, npa (planetary args), sp, cp, se, ce (coefficients in 0.1 µas).

luni_solar.description: 678 luni-solar nutation terms. Each row is an array of 11 numbers matching ls_columns.

planetary.description: 687 planetary nutation terms. Each row is an array of 17 integers matching pl_columns.
